modelNote: model is a blocking factor; the run id names it (opus | sonnet) and launch-agent.sh resolves it here

tools.rationale: REL-001 run-03 K1 tool profile: read/edit files and run a shell; ordo, archcheck and submit are reached through Bash

environment.note: auth and proxy come from the inherited environment (env -i is not used); the unset list stops the orchestrator's additional directories (cohort, ordo, praxis, dokimos) and its CLAUDE.md files, skills, plugins and messaging channel from reaching the trial session; CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SESSION_ID and CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SDK_URL are unset so the orchestrator's session link is not injected into trial sessions (verified: auth still works without them); GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN and CLOUDSDK_AUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN are unset so a trial cannot fetch the experiment repositories over the network; MSBuild node reuse and the build server are off so concurrent trials share no build process

invocation: K1 isolated-cli: one headless `claude -p` per phase (harness/launch-agent.sh), fresh CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and HOME, fresh --session-id, --model from .models[run-id model], per-phase nonce in --append-system-prompt, --tools from .tools.builtIn, --strict-mcp-config with no servers, --permission-mode bypassPermissions (IS_SANDBOX=1 inherited)
prompt: You are a software engineer doing one bounded task. Your complete instructions are in the brief at {BRIEF}. Read it first and follow it exactly, including its limits and workflow, and end your final message as the brief says.
promptNote: the REL-001 run-02/run-03 wrapper prompt, byte for byte; identical in every arm and phase
